text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `retry_if_exception_type._check` used `type(e) in types`, which requires an exact type match, so subclass instances (e.g. `FileNotFoundError` when configured for `OSError`) were not matched.

**Fix:** Changed the check to `isinstance(e, self.exception_types)`, matching the intended semantics (and consistent with the sibling classes `retry_if_not_exception_type`/`retry_unless_exception_type`, which already used `isinstance`).

final_text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `retry_if_exception_type._check` used `type(e) in types`, which requires an exact type match, so subclass instances (e.g. `FileNotFoundError` when configured for `OSError`) were not matched.

**Fix:** Changed the check to `isinstance(e, self.exception_types)`, matching the intended semantics (and consistent with the sibling classes `retry_if_not_exception_type`/`retry_unless_exception_type`, which already used `isinstance`).
